reason: The README clearly presents this plugin as a media toolkit for image understanding, screenshot review, and image generation through configurable external AI providers.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解、截图审查和图像生成功能，并通过用户配置的外部模型服务进行处理。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with image understanding, screenshot review, and image generation through user-configured external model providers.

capabilities: Analyzes user-provided images and screenshots through configured vision providers
Generates images through configured image-generation providers
Sends image-related requests to external AI service providers
Reads locally configured API credentials for provider access
